sectors.ai: Buy selective laggards with confirmed volume breakouts (EL, BEEF, IATA) while avoiding crowded momentum names; the sector's aggregate gain masks divergence, so rotate into mid-cap staples with earnings catalysts and hold through Q3 as domestic consumption stabilizes.
